# nodus-auth

> JWT/API-key/bcrypt authentication. Requires bcrypt<5.0 (passlib 1.7.4 incompatibility).
> Part of the [Masterplan Infinite Weave](https://www.the-master-plan.com/) ecosystem.
> Created by Shawn Knight.

**Notes:** Depends on PyJWT>=2.15.1 (the floor is security-relevant -- see
SECURITY.md), passlib, bcrypt<5.0, pydantic, pydantic-settings>=2.14.2.

## Status

v0.2.0 — published on PyPI. All GitHub repos aligned at github.com/Masterplanner25.

0.2.0 moved the JWT backend from python-jose (critical advisory, no fixed
release) to PyJWT>=2.15.1, and refuses asymmetric key material under an HMAC
algorithm. 0.1.x is not supported.

## Install

```
pip install nodus-auth
pip install -e . --no-deps  # dev install
```
